title: Human-approved restart from the September 1 research resume index
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 1 request to resume research from the saved research-unit index and to accept later steering. Begin with bounded public-information follow-ups for SSW-01-U04 and the EEA1 performance surface, preserving every prior record and open Gap. Compare the distinct roles of feature validation, kernel-level performance comparison and application-level benchmark results, and state which portability, correctness, engineering-effort and maintenance questions remain unsupported. Separate the 36 legacy uncalibrated what-if calculations from formal numerical forecasts without changing their values or erasing their former identifiers; formal forecasts must remain empty until calibration, independent validation and Consensus satisfy the declared contract. Prepare bilingual provisional evidence for review. This does not approve scientific conclusions, close a Gap, authorize hardware execution, enable unattended agents, merge a pull request or deploy GitHub Pages.
